about: The Japanese Cutling TikTok posts (card ASG221), each with its time; words come from copy-ja.json. Nothing is scheduled before the owner's go on the review page; the Dec 1-3 films also wait for Cutling 2.0 READY_FOR_SALE.
why: On @monholt, the one Japanese-language post (the Cutling bank-number film, Nov 18) drew 27.7% Japanese viewers, all from For You. No English or Indonesian post drew more than 1.2%. Japanese viewers come for Japanese words.
account: @monholt, not a new Japanese account: the Japanese post found Japan there with one follower, and a new account starts from nothing. Opening @monholtjapan later needs your yes.
elevenlabs: The voice alone did not pull Japan: the English and Indonesian ElevenLabs films drew none. The one post that did spoke Japanese through ElevenLabs, so every film here keeps the same Japanese voice.
go: Each film goes on TikTok Studio at its time, marked Your brand like the English ones, and is logged in social-posts.md.

posts.name: Type it once
posts.why: Remade as the Cutling 2.0 film's world (ASG251). An address is typed on the iPhone's Japanese keypad while a giant count keeps up, 30 presses in all; the candidate bar shows iOS's own guesses from a real iOS 27.2 run (東京鳥栖, 公園, 高円寺味) and one tap turns the row into kanji. Sent once, it becomes a cutling; then the address, an account number and a Wi-Fi password are one tap each, on the music's drop.

posts.name: What's new in 2.0
posts.why: The 2.0 release film, recorded on the real 2.0 build in Japanese. It opens with the name typed in Messages first (なかむら, converted to 中村), then the saved reply tapped in Cutling, which fills the name in. The date beat types 12月1日.
posts.gate: Goes out only once Cutling 2.0 is on the App Store.

posts.name: Five names
posts.why: Remade (ASG251). A pottery shop, four customers, the same question. Each name is typed on the kana keypad and converted, the globe brings up Cutling, 発送連絡 is tapped, and the name just typed flies into the reply's blank (Cutling 2.0 fills the first blank with the word typed before it). Faster each time; on the drop the one cutling sits over the four replies it wrote, 中村, 小林, 松本, 岡田.
posts.gate: Goes out only once Cutling 2.0 is on the App Store.

posts.name: Five taps
posts.why: Remade (ASG251). 小料理つむぎ answers a booking: only 高橋 is typed, then five taps, counted big: あいさつ, its ✓, 予約OK, 4名様, しめの挨拶. The reply goes out on the drop as one long bubble, each part marked with the taps that made it.
posts.gate: Goes out only once Cutling 2.0 is on the App Store.
